top_choice_rationale: The narrowly framed GLP-1-physiology award best combines a mature fundamental physiological discovery with exceptionally broad, durable, directly established therapeutic consequences in diabetes and obesity. Its three-person attribution is defensible only because the citation confines recognition to the enabling physiology rather than the wider distributed drug-development enterprise.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile. My documented collaboration with Ronald Evans concerns nuclear-receptor research and no connection to this proposed achievement is identified.
